feed.title: RoPI
feed.subtitle: RoPI is a research group at the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki working at the intersection of artificial intelligence, computer vision, and robotics.

entry.title: The RoPI website is live
entry.content: Welcome to the website of the Robot Perception and Intelligence (RoPI) group! Here you will find our research, publications, team, and news.

entry.title: Young Researcher Excellence Award
entry.content: Nikolaos Passalis received the Young Researcher Excellence Award (Engineering/Informatics) from the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki. Read the announcement.
